title: Kenworth T950 FUPS Road Train Bullbar #32
description: Kenworth T950 heavy duty high tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar with 88mm pipe, main pipes are one piece through drilled heavy duty extended uprights and lower cowcatcher bar with 4 small uprights. Reversable aluminium Road Train or Long Load signs as required. Heavy duty tow pin and steel backing plate. Choice of 76 or 100mm pipe. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification.
